1/2 : curl_test_https_tls12 ipv4 : nfqws2 --payload=tls_client_hello --lua-desync=fake:blob=fake_default_tls:tcp_md5

blockcheck optimizes test sequence. To save time some strategies can be skipped if their test is considered useless.
That's why COMMON intersection can miss strategies that would work for all domains, and COVERAGE counts can undercount.
Use "force" scan level to test all strategies and generate trustable results.
Current scan level was "quick".

Please note this SUMMARY does not guarantee a magic pill for you to copy/paste and be happy.
Understanding how strategies work is very desirable.
